Subscriptions, Trials, Cancellation & Refunds

Effective September 24, 2026 · Version 2.7

On iOS, Apple handles all of this — not Remvoll. > > Subscriptions are sold through the App Store and billed to your Apple Account. Remvoll never sees, handles, or stores your payment details, and cannot charge, refund, or cancel anything on your behalf. > > - To see or cancel a subscription: Settings › your name › Subscriptions, or the App Store app › your account › Subscriptions. > - To cancel before a free trial ends: cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, or it renews at the stated price. > - Renewal: subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. The price and period are shown on the purchase screen before you buy and again by Apple at confirmation. > - To request a refund: use Apple's process at reportaproblem.apple.com. Refund decisions are Apple's to make, under the terms of the Apple Media Services agreement. > > The sections below describe Remvoll's own policies where they apply; where they conflict with Apple's rules for App Store purchases, Apple's rules govern.
How buying works here. There is no checkout inside Remvoll. Tapping a plan hands you to Apple's own purchase sheet, and Apple bills your Apple Account. Remvoll never collects a card number and cannot charge you.

1. The free trial, plainly

  • Remvoll starts with a one-time one-month free trial, with full access to everything included in the plan you chose. One month is the trial length Apple offers; there is no 30-day option in the App Store, so the app says "1 month free" everywhere.
  • You are charged $0 today and $0 during the free month. When the free month ends, it becomes a paid subscription automatically at the price shown before you started it, unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. If you cancel during the trial you are never charged, and you keep access until the trial's scheduled end.
  • Trials are granted by Apple, once per Apple Account across both plans, and eligibility is Apple's to determine. If you switch plans during a free trial, the trial ends and the new plan begins right away. We may withhold or revoke trials we reasonably determine are being abused.
  • A reminder before it ends. If you allow notifications, Remvoll reminds you two days before your free trial ends. The reminder is scheduled on your device.

2. Plans and pricing

  • Plan — Monthly — Yearly — Includes
  • Sleep Core — $3.99 — $34.99 — The full sound engine and library, Breath Entrainment in every sound, the Ease in wind-down, Tone/Space/Drift controls, unlimited presets, alarms and the sleep timer, offline playback
  • Sleep Studio — $5.99 — $49.99 — Everything in Sleep Core, plus Smart Wake, Two Stage Alarm, the Sleep Score with sleep history and 30-night trends, app blocking (on a schedule or after an alarm), Jet Lag Mode, nap and focus programs, opt-in room listening (Count noise and Auto volume), the Activity control, shareable preset codes, seasonal collections

There are two plans, sold in one App Store subscription group, so you hold one plan at a time. Moving up to Sleep Studio takes effect right away, and Apple credits the unused part of Sleep Core. Moving down to Sleep Core takes effect at your next renewal. Monthly and yearly plans come with the same one-month free trial, once per Apple Account across both plans. Overnight playback is never rate-limited or capped on any paid plan. The prices displayed in the application at the moment of purchase always govern that purchase, and may differ by region, currency, taxes, and app-store rules.

3. How and when you are billed

  • Subscriptions are sold on a recurring basis and, unless canceled, renew automatically at the then-current price at the end of each billing period (monthly or yearly, as selected).
  • Your first charge occurs only after any free trial ends, and only if you have not canceled by then.
  • Every purchase is billed by Apple to your Apple Account and is subject to Apple's own billing, renewal and cancellation mechanics.
  • Applicable taxes may be added by Apple at purchase.

4. Cancellation

  • You can cancel at any time, during a trial or a paid period, in Settings › your name › Subscriptions on your iPhone. Settings › Manage subscription in the app opens the same Apple sheet.
  • Canceling during the trial means you are never billed. You keep full access until the trial's scheduled end.
  • Canceling a paid subscription stops all future renewals. You retain access to the paid features until the end of the period you have already paid for; access is not cut off mid-period.
  • To avoid the next charge, cancel at least 24 hours before the current period renews (store policies may specify their own cut-off).

5. Refunds

  • Apple handles every refund. All subscriptions are bought through the App Store, so refunds are decided by Apple under Apple's policy and must be requested at reportaproblem.apple.com. Remvoll cannot issue, approve or deny a refund for an App Store purchase, and cannot see the outcome of your request.
  • Statutory rights. If you are a consumer in the EU/EEA, UK, or another jurisdiction with mandatory withdrawal or refund rights, those rights apply and are honored. Note that where you expressly request immediate access to digital content and acknowledge the loss of the withdrawal right, statutory withdrawal may not apply. Every purchase is an App Store purchase, so Apple's refund process at reportaproblem.apple.com remains available to you in every case.
  • Billing errors. Duplicate charges, charges after a valid cancellation, or amounts that do not match the price shown at purchase are refunded in full, promptly, upon verification.

6. Price changes

We may change subscription prices prospectively. Existing subscribers will receive at least 30 days' advance in-app notice, and any new price applies only from the next renewal following the notice period. You may cancel before the change takes effect; continuing your subscription after that date constitutes acceptance of the new price.

7. Failed payments, lapses, and reactivation

If a renewal payment fails, Apple may retry for a limited period and will notify you. If payment cannot be collected, access simply pauses; no debt accrues to us, because we never bill you. Your locally-stored data — presets, preferences, and history — remains on your device regardless of membership state, and access is restored when you resubscribe.

8. Promotional offers

We may from time to time offer discounts, extended trials, or promotional pricing subject to additional terms disclosed at the time of the offer. Promotions are limited, non-transferable, have no cash value, and may be modified or withdrawn except where doing so is prohibited by law.

9. Taxes

Prices in the app are shown exactly as Apple reports them for your storefront, in your currency, inclusive or exclusive of tax according to local rules. Apple collects and remits tax where required.

Billing questions: support@remvoll.com.

Remvoll runs entirely on your device. Questions: legal@remvoll.app
